description.value: A riverside campground in the small community of Rock Creek along Highway 3 in BC's Boundary region, offering a natural riparian setting for touring cyclists on the Crowsnest corridor. Fee-based with washrooms; further details unavailable as the Facebook listing could not be fetched.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Facebook page confirms the campground is real and open: a June 1, 2026 post explicitly states 'We are open for the summer 2026 season.' The page intro identifies it as a campground along the Kettle River and provides an address (1680 Hwy 33, Rock Creek, BC) not present in OSM. OSM tags supply most amenity data (tents=yes, shower=no, toilets=yes, power_supply=no, openfire=yes, picnic_table=yes); these are used cautiously per the rules, with shower=no treated as explicit negative evidence. The Facebook post also implies reservations are accepted for larger groups ('first come first serve again unless you are a bigger reservation').
concerns: Website is a Facebook page only; no dedicated business website available, limiting amenity detail.
Phone number (+1-250-869-7515) comes from OSM only; not visible in the fetched Facebook content.
OSM address field is empty; address sourced from Facebook page (1680 Hwy 33, Rock Creek, BC).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating campground with a confirmed 2026 season opening per a June 2026 Facebook post. Suitable stop for touring cyclists on Highway 33.

wow_evidence: natural riparian setting for touring cyclists on the Crowsnest corridor
